name: Telepathic Whispers
disable: DC 40 Occultism check or DC 40 Religion check (expert) to ward off the spirits' influence, DC 42 Intimidation check (trained) to silence the whispers. A PC who brandishes the gaze of eternity gains a +2 item bonus to their checks. Three successes total are required to disable the haunt.
reset: The hazard deactivates after 1 minute or after the spirits have answered three questions, whichever comes first. It resets after 24 hours.
routine: (1 action) The spirits peer into the minds of up to three creatures in the area. Each creature attempts a DC 40 Will save save. On a failure, the target must choose to either divulge a closely guarded secret or take 4d8+18 mental damage. On a critical success, the target can ask the haunt a question, which the spirits answer truthfully to the best of their ability.

items.name: Answer
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the chamber

---
Effect The spirits whisper in a chorus of sibilant voices. Each creature in the area takes 3d12+18 mental damage, with a DC 42 basic Will save save. A creature that doesn't understand Sakvroth gains a +4 circumstance bonus to their save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: The spirits of the dead entice visitors with forbidden knowledge.
